essence: A month-long worship with white lotuses yields a specific ritual fruit.
The practitioner gains liberation and eloquence like Bṛhaspati.
The mantra practitioner removes sin and gains the allure of Kāma.
Worship should be performed in sequence with kahlāra and sindhuvāra flowers as before.
Even sin accumulated over a thousand births is destroyed by this worship.
